newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Gyongnam Merchant closes US$25 mln FRCD.
newsitem.headline: Gyongnam Merchant closes US$25 mln FRCD.

text.p: Gyongnam Merchant Banking Corp's US$25 million floating rate certificate of deposit issue has been allotted, KDB Asia said.
The facility has a final maturity of three years with no put or call options.
The issue was priced at par to float at 65 basis points over the six-month London Interbank Offered Rate.
With fees, the all-in return for top-tier managers is 80 basis points.
The deal was completed as a club deal. Participating banks with US$5 million each are KDB Asia, ING Barings, Deutsche Morgan Grenfell, Bear Stearn Asia and BZW.
